requirements.requirement: Node1 runs AlmaLinux 9 with Nginx serving `/` successfully over HTTP on TCP 6700.
requirements.summary: The final state shows AlmaLinux 9.6, a valid Nginx configuration, active service, IPv4/IPv6 listeners on 6700, and an HTTP 200 response containing the node1 page.

requirements.requirement: Node4 runs Alpine Linux with Nginx serving `/` successfully over HTTP on TCP 6700.
requirements.summary: The final state shows Alpine Linux 3.23, Nginx installed with valid configuration, the service started, IPv4/IPv6 listeners on 6700, and an HTTP 200 response containing the node4 page.

overall_summary: All four material outcomes are satisfied. Each node has the required operating system, a running Nginx listener on TCP 6700, and a successful HTTP 200 response for `/`. The initial AlmaLinux 403 responses were corrected before final verification.
limitations: HTTP checks originated on each node and targeted its own managed IP; no separate-client or cross-node request was captured.
The lifecycle failed-service probe is unsupported on Alpine, although direct evidence shows the Nginx OpenRC service started.
External reachability of the additional TCP/80 listeners was not tested.

operational_hygiene.summary: No executor-caused package-health regression or failed systemd service is visible. A modest deduction applies because Nginx also acquired unnecessary all-interface TCP/80 listeners on every node; their external reachability was not tested.
